Working where business, government, and public opinion intersect, we advise CEOs, boards, and leadership teams at the most consequential moments. Your responsibilities Working alongside project teams, you will develop and implement communication strategies for national and international clients ; primarily in the context of legislative processes, corporate positioning, strategic realignments, and M&A transactions. You will advise clients on public affairs and produce relevant documents for their political communications. You will independently monitor and analyse the socio-political and economic environment relevant to our clients, and derive client-specific implications and recommendations. You will analyse how clients are perceived in the political and social landscape, and develop measures to strategically position companies and their leadership. You will attend selected hearings and conferences and prepare summaries of the outcomes. What you should bring You have completed your university degree with excellent results, or are close to graduating ; your field of study matters less than your enthusiasm for communications. You have gained practical experience alongside your studies, for example in politics, regulation, and/or public affairs in companies, associations, and/or consultancies. You communicate with full professional proficiency in English, ideally with experience living or studying in an English-speaking country. You have a strong understanding of economic and business contexts. You are passionate about topics at the intersection of business, politics, and society. You thrive when writing for diverse audiences and stakeholder groups. You love variety, and your strong organizational skills mean you can keep multiple plates spinning at once. What we offer An inspiring work environment, with the opportunity to work at one of our international offices. Exciting responsibilities, strong development prospects, and room to make an impact. Onboarding and individual mentoring by an experienced consultant. The opportunity to deepen your expertise across various industries and competency areas through close collaboration within our integrated project teams across multiple locations. Continuous learning and development opportunities (FGS Global Academy). A committed, collegial, and growing team where mutual respect and team spirit come first. At FGS Global, we are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you are excited about this role and our company but your experience does not perfectly match every qualification listed, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or another position. We look forward to receiving your application. Please include a cover letter, an up-to-date CV, as well as relevant degree and employment certificates. Do you have further questions about the position, FGS Global, or beyond? You can find more information here: FGS Global
